Corollary
[HEP inclusion homotopy equivalence implies deformation retract]

↗ prop:hep-homotopy-equivalence-rel-a

1. ch0:0.20\group CW Complexes

If $(X,A)$ has HEP and $A\hookrightarrow X$ is a homotopy equivalence, then $A$ is a deformation retract of $X$.

Proof

\sketch Apply the proposition to the inclusion of pairs $(A,A)\to (X,A)$. Its relative homotopy inverse is a retraction $r:X\to A$ with $\iota r\simeq \one _X$ rel $A$, which is a deformation retraction.

□
